text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With only one day left in summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Kh... As expected, my legs are losing power...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san, if it's too painful...
please hold onto me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
Though, you look quite pale yourself, Chiyono O...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san! Chiyono O-san!
Are you two okay!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes... This is... h-happening all the time, so...
I'll be back on my feet in just a little bit...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please do not overexert yourself...
Even Ardan-san seems unsteady on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I am aware I'm pushing myself a bit too hard.
From morning until this hour,
I have spent every moment training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, with the race approaching, I must make up for lost time.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: !! Returning to racing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. It has been decided that I will run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah! The Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm scheduled to make my comeback soon too!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Is that so... Finally...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, finally.
Finally, everyone will be able to see how I run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
People might ask who that girl is,
but that's way better than being forgotten entirely.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Before we knew it, Oguri-san became popular.
People started saying Oguri-san and Creek-san
were carrying the whole generation."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No one even cared about
who won the Satsuki Sho
or the Japan Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"The crown we poured our heart and soul into wanting to claim...
In that moment, I even began to doubt...
wondering if it had all just been a fleeting dream."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —It was truly a humiliating, regretful feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, on the other hand, there was a ray of hope for us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You kept running to strike a blow against Miss Oguri and the others,
to overturn overwhelming public opinion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just as you promised
when you said you'd protect the place we return to.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing Yaeno stick to her own style
even amidst the tremendous cheers for Oguri...
inspired me."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I felt like I had to run alongside Yaeno-san, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Don't sulk around worrying if you'll be forgotten! Go out there and etch your running into their minds!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Once Chiyono O-san and I return,
all three of us who fought in the Japanese Derby will be together again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The public hails Oguri-san and the others as the 'Eternal Big Three,' but as our own 'Big Three'—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let us compete upon the same stage.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The "Big Three"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A performance worthy of being called one of the "Big Three"...
I have trained relentlessly with that goal in mind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't a whole lot we could do, but
I'm working on training that's even harder than before the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm finally back on the turf...
I'll pour everything I've got into this run!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"My life was already burned to ashes once at the Japanese Derby.
I have no regrets now.
If I am to decay upon the turf, it would be my true desire."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When my time as a hidden dragon comes to an end,
I shall shine brighter than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'll aim beyond my limits as well!
So I won't lose to Yaeno-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (The two of them are prepared to stake everything...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (...Is it really okay for me to stay like this...?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (—No, this cannot be good...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*...
*Exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"—Sei! Haa!
Haa! Taa!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: âBEGONE!!" hisses!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Is that...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Miss Oguri—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —...Feels good...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's run a little more.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How so freely and effortlessly she runs—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
As natural as drawing breath.
A fundamental activity etched deep into instinct and flesh.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Just run.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Running in a state of absolute selflessness—that was how it felt.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Carrying this raging passion, I could never reach it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And she is basking in the undivided acclaim of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Everything about them was the polar opposite of me.
...That is precisely why I wished for it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I want to beat Oguri-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I want to surpass her and stand within that very same light.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I want to defeat her—the one praised as the strongest, who has mastered complete selflessness!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I wish to win, and make it proof of my strength!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And... we will change the era.
Together with Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "As the 'Big Three,' we will forge an era where we serve as the pillars supporting our generation!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —The strength for that! A weapon!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can already see it... In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will seize it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. As soon as our eyes met,
Yaeno Muteki led me to a quiet spot away from the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer-dono.
Please hear my resolution.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I want to surrender myself to the passion raging within me
and see if I can turn it into a power that transcends all limits."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If it can serve as a weapon
to surpass Oguri-san and join the 'Big Three'!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I would like to pursue that possibility!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With eyes burning with a passion that felt like fire,
Yaeno Muteki made her appeal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking into her eyes, I knew she had made up her mind.
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I promised that if Yaeno Muteki wanted to try it,
I would give her my full, prepared support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've identified potential impacts
and prepared countermeasures just in case. Even so,
unforeseen circumstances could still arise...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Backing her determination and supporting her
is my duty as her Trainer—!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on your help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp concluded
with Yaeno Muteki's declaration of resolve—
